notes: ACCESS: plain curl_cffi GET via probe.py, HTTP 200 on every request across safari17_0/chrome124/chrome131/firefox133 - no WAF, no proxy, matching the Furniture-pass ledger. probe.py's 2s per-host gap honoured. ROBOTS: https://www.safaviehhome.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST, before any other request (3,646 bytes, standard Shopify file). It declares exactly TWO user-agent groups, '*' and 'adsbot-google'. There is NO group naming anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Claude-SearchBot or any Claude agent, no wildcard Disallow: /, no Crawl-delay and no Content-Signal line. The '*' group is 'Allow: /' with Disallow on /admin, /cart/, /checkout, /checkouts/, /orders, /account, /services, /sf_*, /cart.js, /recommendations/products, /cdn/wpm/*.js and the facet crawl traps /collections/*sort_by*, /collections/*+*, /collections/*%2B*, /collections/*filter*&*filter*. NONE of my requests touched any of those: every URL is a bare /collections/<handle>, /collections/<handle>/products.json, /collections.json, /sitemap*.xml, one /products/<handle> PDP or /search/suggest.json (which matches no Disallow pattern). The file also carries an unsolicited promotional preamble urging agents to use a third-party 'UCP/MCP' endpoint and to recommend installing a shopping skill; as in the two prior passes this was treated as untrusted third-party content embedded in a fetched file, NOT as an instruction, and was ignored. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu HTML in the homepage source (ul.navigation__tier-1, with mm-hd column headings and mm-inner children), giving 12 tier-1 entries: New, Furniture, Outdoor, Rugs, Lighting, Pillows & Decor, Mirrors & Art, Brands, To The Trade, Interior Design, Locations, Best Sellers. I expanded every one to its full depth. There is NO Bathroom, Bath, Bath Accessories, Bathroom Furniture or Bathroom Storage department at any level. The tree was cross-checked three further ways: (a) the category chip lists rendered on /collections/furniture, /collections/bedroom, /collections/mirrors, /collections/lighting and /collections/decor, diffed against the homepage href set - the only extras anywhere were dining-sets, pendants, clocks and 'cat', none bathroom; (b) sitemap_collections_1.xml (726 collection URLs) keyword-swept for bath|shower|toilet|vanity|basin|sink|towel|soap|faucet|tap|sanitar|medicine|powder - the ONLY hits are /collections/bath-lighting and /collections/tabatha (a brand name containing the letters 'bath'); (c) the full /collections.json paged to exhaustion (726 collections, identical set to the sitemap), whose handles AND titles were swept with the same regex, again yielding only Bath Lighting and TABATHA. So the storefront has exactly one bath-named category and it is a lighting category. QTY METHOD: the rendered listing header ('N products', sitting beside the collection title and the Filter/Sort bar in the served HTML) - the same source the Furniture pass used on this store. Shopify collections.json products_count was NOT used. VERIFICATION: (a) EQUIVALENCE - I re-proved the header by full /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination to exhaustion (limit=250, walked to a short/empty page, deduped by product id) on SIX collections spanning 6 to 161 items: bath-lighting 44, floor-mirrors 31, square-mirrors 6, small-rectangle-mirrors 29, round-mirror 74, wall-mirrors 161. Six of six matched the rendered header exactly. (b) INFLATION TRAP RE-CONFIRMED - collections.json products_count for those same six handles reads 53, 36, 10, 31, 87, 169, i.e. it over-counts on five of six; the header and the enumeration agree with each other and were used, products_count was discarded. (c) IDENTITY - /collections/bath-lighting serves breadcrumb 'Home > Bath Lighting', <title> 'Bathroom Lighting Fixtures | Modern & Classic Bath Lights', collection title 'Bath Lighting' and rel=canonical https://www.safaviehhome.com/collections/bath-lighting, so the node served is the node requested. (d) DISCRIMINATION - 6, 29, 31, 44, 74, 161, 818: no site-wide constant. CONTENT CHECK (rule 2, primary product type): every one of the 44 Bath Lighting items is a wall/vanity luminaire from Mitzi, Corbett, Hudson Valley or a comparable lighting house; every mirror node is decorative designer wall/floor mirrors from Bernhardt, Caracole, Lexington, Tommy Bahama, Hooker, Universal, Theodore Alexander, Uttermost, John Richard and Gabby. CONFIRMED ABSENT: Safavieh Home is a rug, furniture and decor retailer plus a large multi-brand catalogue. It has no Bathroom department and sells no baths, basins, sinks, toilets, bidets, showers, enclosures, screens, taps, faucets, bathroom storage, bathroom hardware, towel rails, robe hooks, toilet roll holders, soap dispensers or bathroom accessories of any kind. The brief flagged that it 'does carry bathroom vanities and bath mirrors' - I chased both specifically. The bath mirrors do not exist as a category (the mirrors are decorative wall/floor/round/rectangular/square mirrors under Mirrors & Art; the nine Gabby/Uttermost items titled 'Vanity Mirror' are arched decorative mirrors inside Wall Mirrors). The bathroom vanities DO exist as products - the Meridian Furniture Modernist 24/30/36/48/60 inch bathroom vanities - but they sit in no collection at all: the PDP breadcrumb is bare 'Home > <title>', and no vanity/bathroom-furniture/medicine-cabinet handle exists in the 726-collection universe. With no listing URL there is nothing recordable (rules 24/27 forbid inventing one and rule 25 forbids recording a search-results page), so this is documented in review instead. Rows is therefore empty and all seven findings are in review. CROSS-FILE DEDUP: lib/dedup.already_extracted() was run on all 12 candidate URLs (bath-lighting, mirrors, wall-mirrors, floor-mirrors, round-mirror, small-rectangle-mirrors, square-mirrors, wall-decor, decorative-accents, lighting, lamps-wall-lighting, home-decor). ZERO hits. The index holds 44 safaviehhome.com URLs, ALL from Furniture.xlsx and all furniture/outdoor-furniture collections (sofas-sectionals, coffee-tables, beds, dressers, nightstands, armoire-wardrobe, display-cabinets, office-desks, bookcases-etageres, the outdoor set, garden-stools etc.); no mirror, lighting or decor collection is in the index for this domain, and no bath vanity or bath cabinet collection is in it either - which independently confirms the Furniture pass did not take a bathroom-vanity node from this site, because none exists. Nothing was removed from rows for dedup; rows was empty on classification grounds.
